title: Carrots in Herb Butter
preamble:
2 tbsp. Butter

2 tbsp. Water

1 tsp. Sugar

4 c. quartered carrots

Salt and white pepper to taste
ingredients: Salt and white pepper to taste
1 tsp. snipped fresh tarragon or 1/4 tsp. dried whole tarragon, crushed
method: In heavy saucepan, combine butter, water and sugar.
Add carrots, cover tightly and cook over low heat 15 to 20 minutes or until tender.
